verdict.rationale: RingCentral's own marketing says it can plug the phone system into CRMs such as Salesforce and HubSpot, so a first-party CRM integration exists. Nothing in the evidence describes automatic logging of calls or texts, or matching activity to the right contact. The call-log API and the notifications/subscriptions docs are developer building blocks and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented automatic call and SMS activity logging to the CRM, contact-matching behavior, integration-specific docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
